aiThesis.title: Your AI agents will never be better than the data and processes you give them.
aiThesis.lead: Many AI projects never get past the proof of concept. The models are fine: they work on data scattered across dozens of tools, definitions that change from one team to the next, and processes nobody ever wrote down.
aiThesis.conclusion: To take AI past the proof of concept, we structure the context first: reliable data, documented processes, accessible knowledge.
aiThesis.step1.title: Scattered
aiThesis.step1.text: Dozens of tools and files, nothing connected. The AI sees nothing.
aiThesis.step2.title: Clean up
aiThesis.step2.text: We remove duplicates, side files and whatever is no longer used.
aiThesis.step3.title: Structure
aiThesis.step3.text: Every tool finds its place: foundation, context, activation.
aiThesis.step4.title: Activate
aiThesis.step4.text: Your AI finally reaches a reliable context, and produces useful results.
aiThesis.stageLabel: Animation: scattered, disconnected tools are cleaned up, then organised into three blocks connected to the AI.
